variants.title: Clean illustrated puppet
variants.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create one polished landscape game-art concept, approximately 3:2, for a small personal dog game called Ebi's Adventure. No words or UI in the image.
Input images are SUBJECT REFERENCES and kitchen references, not art style references: photo 1 shows the real Ebi standing at her home's oven; photo 2 shows her forehead markings and adult body. Preserve her specific likeness: adult ginger-orange and white Pomsky, pale ice-blue eyes with dark rims, erect triangular ears, a white central forehead blaze continuing into a white fox-like muzzle, black nose, white chest and lower legs, dark slim collar, fluffy cream-tipped curled tail. Slightly simplify and enlarge the head for readability, but keep an adult dog body and expressive, intelligent face; not a generic round Pomeranian, not a puppy or plush toy.
COMPOSITION LOCK: a straight-on side-view kitchen game screen, camera at dog shoulder height, no isometric view. A warm wood-fronted low cabinet/counter occupies the RIGHT half, its dark grey stone top at approximately twice Ebi's shoulder height. On the counter's leftmost edge closest to Ebi, a light grey moulded-pulp egg tray with six brown eggs. Ebi stands on all four paws on the floor immediately LEFT of this cabinet, facing RIGHT in three-quarter profile so one pale blue eye and some white blaze are visible, head tipped up eyeing the eggs, ears alert, cheeky intent. All four paws visible with anatomically correct limbs. Dog body occupies about one third of image width; do not make her a tiny background character. Simple pale square wall tiles and grey floor tiles, warm wood cabinet fronts echo her real home. One black oven door in the rear, a small sage tea towel. Spacious, edited composition with quiet background and clear warm ginger focal character. Soft warm daylight from upper left. Entire dog and entire tray inside frame with margin. Dog, kitchen and tray share one illustration style, lighting and scale. No action pose, no panels, no text, no labels, no watermark, no hands, no people, no other animals, no game interface.
ART DIRECTION A: professional 2D illustrated paper-puppet game art. Beautiful clean hand-designed silhouettes, angular yet friendly fluffy fur tufts, confident smooth contour in warm dark brown, flat warm ginger and cream colour masses with only two or three softly separated cel-shading values. Subtle matte paper grain, restrained depth and highlights, no photographic fur strands and no thick sticker border. Palette cream, terracotta, warm oak, desaturated sage and charcoal. Ebi's face must be exceptionally appealing and recognisable, with a convincing fox-like muzzle, alert blue eye, slight mischievous closed-mouth smile. Background shapes simple and elegant, with finer lighter outlines than the dog. Cohesive art suitable for a charming finished indie game. It should look art-directed and drawn by an accomplished illustrator, not generated clipart or procedural circles. Prioritise the appealing character design over decorative background detail.
